# Thamco360

> Thamco360 is a Google Trusted photography provider based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. It captures 360° panoramic photography on site and delivers it as navigable virtual tours — published directly to a client's Google Business Profile so the tour appears in Google Search and Google Maps, and embeddable in the client's own website. It is a service-area business: the scan crew travels to the property, there is no showroom to visit.

## Key facts
- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Service-area business, no fixed storefront.
- Contact: +91 70901 11360 (phone and WhatsApp), thamco360@gmail.com. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thamco360/
- Scan crews deploy within 48 hours of booking. Most residential and commercial properties are captured in a single same-day visit.
- Google Trusted provider: finished tours are published to Google Business Profile, so they surface in Google Search and Google Maps beside the business listing.

## Services
- **Google Trusted Photography** — 360° capture published directly to the client's Google Business Profile.
- **360° Virtual Tour** — on-site panoramic capture stitched into a seamless navigable walkthrough viewable in any browser.
- **Website Development** — a custom site built around the finished tour, so it is embedded rather than only linked.
- **Web 3D Development (Immersive)** — interactive browser-based 3D experiences built on captured spatial imagery.

## How a tour is produced
1. **Capture** — a panoramic head sweeps every angle of the space on site.
2. **Stitch** — overlapping circular fisheye frames are aligned and blended into one seamless equirectangular sphere.
3. **Refine** — exposure, vertical alignment and fine detail are corrected by hand.
4. **Publish** — the tour goes live on Google Business Profile and on the client's own site.
5. **Experience** — visitors step inside and look around the space from anywhere, in a browser.

## Industries served
Real estate and residential property; hospitality including hotels and resorts; weddings and event venues; museums and galleries. Published work also covers hospitals, dental clinics, cafés, live-music venues, schools and colleges, showrooms, salons, gyms, co-working spaces and service apartments.

## Definitions
- **360° virtual tour**: a drag-driven walkthrough built from high-resolution panoramic photography, letting a website visitor look around and move between rooms in a browser exactly as they would in person.
- **Equirectangular image**: the 2:1 flattened projection of a full sphere, which a 360° viewer maps back onto a sphere around the camera position.
- **Stitching**: joining the overlapping fisheye frames a 360° camera records into that single seamless sphere. The homepage carries a side-by-side comparison of a raw unstitched capture against the finished stitched result.
